scene: You step off the river barge into bustling Spice Bridge.
picture: Flat side view. On the far left sits a wooden river barge moored at a dock. In the lilac headscarf and mustard coat, the player stands beside it. Moving rightward: a spice stall packed with glowing indigo jars, a hanging polished kettle above hot coals, and a rope ladder dangling toward the floor.
shown: A stall stacked with glowing indigo spice jars on the left.
A giant polished copper kettle hanging over coals in the centre.
A hemp rope ladder dangling from bridge rafters on the right.

variants.scene: Salty river air and warm cinnamon scents greet you beneath the stone arches.
Lanterns glow softly along the docks as you continue your search for {quest}.
Chattering crowds and crackling fire coals welcome you to the twilight market.
